## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Leadership concentrated and narrow (4/5 top performers from Technology) with cyclicals/materials participation, supporting a money-rotation environment rather than a broad risk-off.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +6.48% | 1M: +22.97%) ABOVE TREND.  
Financials strong: C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND.  
Technology showing high short-term leadership: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION.  
Utilities weak: sector down 1W; representative weakness noted in news (D -60) and utilities breadth low.  
Consumer Staples soft: PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk as rotation may shift.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, MET (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION, MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -2.02% | 1M: +11.17%) CORRECTION, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select discretionary and healthcare names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND; watch AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY as a divergence (bullish 1W, negative 1M). Major divergence flagged: AAPL, GOOGL and AVGO show 1W/1M disagreement — treat as tactical, not structural confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but leadership-heavy: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +2.25%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%) RECOVERY; Sector breadth: 13/19 positive (internal rotation within tech).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Constructive: C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND; Sector breadth: 14/20 positive — confirms rotation into cyclicals/value.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed/defensive overlay: MRK (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +2.38%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.97% | 1M: -2.90%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +0.46%) CORRECTION; Sector breadth: 9/15 positive — watch for bifurcation between growth biotech and defensive large-caps.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Financials and Materials exposure: C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to lagging staples/discretionary names showing BELOW TREND (PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND). Style: Growth/Momentum leadership in tech but rotation favors cyclicals/value — be selective given narrow tech concentration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND — look for continuation signals.  
BEARISH: AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY (news-negative), PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND — watch for failure to reclaim trend.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (sector 1W: +3.44%; breadth est. 6/7 positive), Financials (sector 1W: +2.78%; breadth est. 14/20 positive), Technology (sector 1W: +2.60%; breadth est. 13/19 positive).  
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (sector 1W: -0.90%; breadth est. 3/12 positive), Utilities (sector 1W: -0.66%; breadth est. 1/6 positive), Consumer Staples (sector 1W: -0.23%; breadth est. 4/11 positive).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND — watch for sustained closes above last week’s high to confirm momentum extension.  
AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%) RECOVERY — monitor ability to reclaim monthly median as confirmation for tech breadth stability.  
JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND — sustained breakout above recent 1M highs would extend financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
C (+55): regulatory relief/banamex progress; C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND — price confirms sentiment.  
MA (+55): partnership news; MA (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND — price confirming.  
AMD (+50): analyst optimism on China demand; AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment aligns with price momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AVGO (-50): negative headlines on post-earnings reaction; AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY — bearish news diverges from 1W rally, monitor for distribution.  
BA (-55): geopolitical/sanctions headlines; BA (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +18.64%) ABOVE TREND — price holding despite negative news (divergence).  
KHC (-50): guidance/corporate change; KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND — price confirms sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with Growth/Momentum leadership concentrated in Technology while Financials and Materials show meaningful participation; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND and C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large-cap tech names (AAPL, GOOGL, AVGO) and mixed news sentiment (AVGO, BA negative headlines) — watch for trend breaks before enlarging positions.
